mechanism: For multi-symbol multi-period standard indicators, locate the source bar with iBarShift(symbol, timeframe, series_time), read calculated-buffer value(s), then fill num_bars=PeriodSeconds(source_tf)/PeriodSeconds(PERIOD_CURRENT) consecutive current-chart bars with that same value so one higher-TF state is held constant across the lower-TF window.
